review_evidence: README explicitly says the repository develops category theory in Lean, including categories, functors, natural transformations, functor categories, isomorphisms/equivalences, comma/slice/coslice categories, limits/colimits, products, and monoidal structures.

The README notes that the repository is obsolete because its contents later entered Mathlib; archival or duplicate status is provenance and does not erase the independent historical source/path/search signal.

Direct source inventory contains 36 Lean files implementing the stated category-theory development; no content-level argument established that any particular formal-source subtree can be removed losslessly from primary search.
summary: Retain the archived category-theory development because it remains genuine historical formalization prior art.
